verdict.rationale: dlt is fundamentally code/CLI-first, and the CLI and MCP server (dlt-docs-10, dlt-docs-72, dlt-probe-4) expose pipeline creation, inspection, debugging, secrets, schema and run management that mirror the dltHub Web UI's monitoring/inspection features (dlt-docs-15). However there is no explicit vendor claim of full UI/API parity and no public OpenAPI spec was found (dlt-probe-3 shows 404s), so some UI-only surface (e.g. app.dlthub.com dashboards) may lack a documented equivalent API path. Missing for 10: explicit parity statement, evidence that every dltHub Web UI feature (dashboards, visual monitoring) has a corresponding documented API/CLI/MCP call, and a public API spec.
